  Raw machine execution — session b2ec06c4a608 (thread 30279).

  - `truesight_autopilot` #473 (PR1) — split the auto-advance convergence signal in `app/main.py::_compute_advance_signal`: `opened_pr` → `pr_opened` + `made_progress`; gate only when NEITHER. A correctly-completed unit that isn't PR-shaped now auto-advances.

Corpus-verified across all 60 plan docs: 0 regressions, 9 plans newly resolve, 1 safe gate.

  - The auto-advance loop treated "no PR opened this turn" as non-convergence, forcing a human "go" on every correctly-completed unit that isn't PR-shaped (DNS verification, pre-flight, docs-only). A second, confirmed-live root cause was a stale duplicate `RESUME HERE` marker latching the parser onto the wrong line.
  
  **Testing / evidence:**

  - `tests/test_auto_advance*.py`: 56 passed.
